text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a research paper focused on invasive species distribution modeling (Rhododendron ponticum) using MAXENT. While it incorporates a land cover simulation for 2050 as one input variable, the primary objective is not national-scale LULC prediction. The central research question is species invasiveness under climate and land cover change. The land cover simulation is an incidental step to generate a future land cover map for the study area (Snowdonia National Park, Wales), not a national-scale implementation for the entire UK. The paper fails the core inclusion criteria of having a primary focus on LULC prediction/simulation and explicit national-scale spatial implementation.)
